name: ps5-cafe-tv-manager
description: LAN-first TV and timed-session manager for a PS5 gaming centre

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @ps5-cafe/server" "npm run dev -w @ps5-cafe/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @ps5-cafe/contracts && npm run build -w @ps5-cafe/server && npm run build -w @ps5-cafe/web
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
